overview: The board discussed preparations for an upcoming trust action plan community meeting, approved an amended draft developer funding application, and voted to support the sale of city-owned parcels to generate funding for the trust. The board also amended and approved its upcoming meeting schedule.

items.title: Trust Action Plan and Community Meeting
items.summary: The board discussed preparations and the facilitation timeline for the upcoming trust action plan community meeting scheduled for March 12th.

items.title: Developer Funding Application Guidelines
items.summary: The board reviewed a draft developer application for housing project funding and approved the document as amended.

items.title: McCormick Avenue Parcels Conveyance
items.summary: The board voted to support the City Council's authorization of the sale of city-owned parcels on McCormick Avenue to fund the trust and an upcoming linkage nexus study.

items.title: Trust Meeting Schedule
items.summary: The board approved its updated meeting schedule as amended, including scheduling a summer meeting for July 16th.
